entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Alex, finally. I need to return this helmet I bought. I've been on hold for ten minutes and I'm losing my patience. Just give me the return label.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your order number?
It's VF-8675309. Now hurry up, this is ridiculous. I expect this to be simple.

Thank you. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the VeloFit Aero-Dynamic helmet, purchased about 50 days ago. To make sure I handle this correctly for you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Are you serious? What does it matter?! The box is unopened! I bought it as a gift and the color is all wrong. It's not what they wanted. I don't want it, and I want my money back. This shouldn't be a 20-questions interrogation. Get me your manager if you can't handle a simple return.

I understand your frustration, and there's no need for a manager. I can definitely handle this for you. I just need to follow the correct procedure. Let me quickly check our return policy for your item.
You'd better. I swear if I get the runaround, I'm lighting you up on every review site on the internet. Your company's service is a joke.

Okay, thank you for holding. I've confirmed the policy. Since the item was delivered 50 days ago, it's still well within our 90-day return window. And since you mentioned the box is unopened, we can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Well, it's about time. See? That wasn't so hard, was it?

Not at all, and I'm happy we can get this sorted out. We definitely want to ensure every rider has the right gear for their needs, especially when it comes to something as important as helmet safety. A proper fit and the right color can make all the difference. I am sending the prepaid return label to the email on file now. Do you see it?
Let me check... yeah, I just got it. Okay. So I just print this and drop it off?

That's correct. Just attach it to the shipping box, and you can drop it off at any carrier location. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
